design_philosophy: Objective, rigid, and functional. Prioritize data clarity, high contrast, and traffic-light system for compliance status (Green/Amber/Red). Eliminate cognitive load by relying heavily on hierarchy and spacing.

headings.usage: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for large text. Sharp, mechanical, and authoritative.

body.usage: Used for data tables, metrics, and standard reading text. Highly legible at small sizes.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Utilize the 'Control Room' Grid for dashboards.

cards.style: Flat solid surfaces with a 1px subtle border (border-slate-200), no shadow by default. Sharp or slightly rounded edges (rounded-md).
cards.hover_state: Slight lift (-translate-y-1), subtle ambient shadow (shadow-sm), border color darkens to slate-300.

buttons.style: High contrast. Primary buttons are solid black with white text. Use robust padding (px-6 py-2.5) and slight radius (rounded-md).
buttons.interaction: Clear hover state with background lightening. Must include focus ring (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-black).

tables.style: Clean data presentation. Sticky headers with subtle background (bg-slate-50). Zebra striping optional but keep borders minimal (border-b border-slate-200 only). Include clear traffic-light status badges.

badges.style: Small, rounded-full, distinct background tints with matching strong text color for statuses (e.g., bg-red-100 text-red-700).

navigation.style: Sidebar or top nav with Solid Background (bg-white or bg-slate-900 if inversion is desired for contrast). Never use transparent backgrounds. Clearly denote active states with a bold indicator (e.g., left border).

motion.page_load: staggered fade-in and slide-up (translate-y-4 to 0, opacity 0 to 1) for dashboard widgets.

icons.style: Sharp, clean, and stroke-based. Size 20px for general use, 16px for inline data.

image_urls.description: Orange logistics truck driving on highway
image_urls.usage: Can be used as a subtle background for the login page, heavily overlaid with white or black (opacity 0.8) to maintain text legibility.
Use as a placeholder for the logged-in Fleet Manager user profile avatar in the header.

testing.attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='defect-report-card').

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette provided, prioritizing the traffic-light status system for compliance items.
Use Chivo for all headings and IBM Plex Sans for body and data.
Implement Shadcn UI for complex components like data tables, select dropdowns, and date pickers.
Ensure the dashboard uses the 'Control Room' grid layout for dense data correlation.
The UI must be responsive, defaulting to a single-column stacked view on mobile devices (crucial for drivers reporting defects).
Add data-testid attributes to all buttons, links, form inputs, and key widgets.
Ensure high contrast ratios (minimum 4.5:1) for all text and data points.
Do not use generic font families like Inter or Roboto for headings.
